kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
عققت (form I)
# عَقَقْتُ (ʕaqaqtu) /ʕa.qaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of عَقَّ (ʕaqqa)
# عَقَقْتَ (ʕaqaqta) /ʕa.qaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of عَقَّ (ʕaqqa)
# عَقَقْتِ (ʕaqaqti) /ʕa.qaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of عَقَّ (ʕaqqa)
# عُقِقْتُ (ʕuqiqtu) /ʕu.qiq.tu/: first-person singular past passive of عَقَّ (ʕaqqa)
# عُقِقْتَ (ʕuqiqta) /ʕu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
